<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2 bootstrap</title>
  <style>
    body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background-color: #f0f0f0;
    }
    main {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      height: 100vh;
      padding: 20px;
      background-color: #fff;
    }
    h1 {
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .game-container {
      width: 80%;
      max-width: 800px;
      background-color: #fff;
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }
    .game-board {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 50px);
      grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 50px);
      gap: 5px;
      margin: 20px 0;
    }
    .game-piece {
      width: 50px;
      height: 50px;
      background-color: #ccc;
      border: 2px solid #999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: #333;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .game-piece.selected {
      background-color: #007bff;
      color: white;
    }
    .game-piece.ai {
      background-color: #007bff;
      color: white;
    }
    .game-piece.enemy {
      background-color: #ff4081;
      color: white;
    }
    .game-piece.empty {
      background-color: #eee;
    }
    .game-actions {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .game-actions button {
      padding: 10px 15px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border: 2px solid #999;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background-color: #f0f0f0;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color 0.2s;
    }
    .game-actions button:hover {
      background-color: #e0e0e0;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>

  <script>
    // Game logic and implementation would go here

    // failure/success or escalating progression, restart, responsive layout, and no external network dependency.

    // Placeholder for game initialization
    function initGame() {
      // Initialize game board, pieces, AI, and game state
      // Set up event listeners for touch input, movement, combat, and progression
      // Implement AI for opponent
      // Handle restart and progression
    }

    // Start the game
    initGame();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
